creative-writing.title: Creative writing (router)
creative-writing.intro: Describe what you want to make (a story, chapter, edit, world, graphic novel or illustration brief) and the router picks the right approach.
creative-writing.starter: I want to write a graphic novel about a lighthouse keeper who finds a door in the sea. Where should I start?

story-init.title: Start a new story
story-init.intro: Set up a new fiction project: title, genre, premise and the files a story project needs.

fields.label: Working title
fields.placeholder: The Salt Door

fields.label: Genre and audience
fields.placeholder: Adult literary fantasy

fields.label: Premise or idea

fields.label: Anything else
fields.placeholder: Tone, comparable books, length target

premise-workshop.title: Premise workshop
premise-workshop.intro: Brainstorm and stress-test a story idea or logline in conversation.
premise-workshop.starter: What if a city's dreams were collected each morning and sold at market? Is this strong enough for a novel?

discovery-drafting.title: Discovery drafting
discovery-drafting.intro: Write without an outline: find the story kernel, push through dead ends, reconcile what you discovered.
discovery-drafting.starter: I'm pantsing a mystery and I'm stuck at chapter 6 - my detective has no next move.

plot-structure.title: Plot structure
plot-structure.intro: Build or repair a plot arc, act structure, timeline, pacing and foreshadowing.

fields.label: Story summary
fields.placeholder: Who wants what, what stands in the way, how it ends (if known)

fields.label: What you need
fields.placeholder: Full outline / fix the sagging middle / place the midpoint / track foreshadowing

character-management.title: Characters
character-management.intro: Create or update characters: profiles, arcs, relationships, family trees and timelines.

fields.label: Character name(s)
fields.placeholder: Mara Quell

fields.label: Role in the story
fields.placeholder: Protagonist, lighthouse keeper, 34

fields.label: What you know so far
fields.placeholder: Backstory, wants, fears, quirks, relationships

worldbuilding.title: Worldbuilding
worldbuilding.intro: Locations, magic and technology systems, politics, religion, economy, history and maps.

fields.label: The world so far
fields.placeholder: Setting, era, tone, what already exists

fields.label: Requirements and constraints
fields.placeholder: Hard rules, costs, what the plot needs from it

theme-craft.title: Theme
theme-craft.intro: Find and sharpen the controlling idea, the lie the protagonist believes, motifs and the antagonist as argument.
theme-craft.starter: My story is about grief, but it feels like a topic rather than a theme. Help me find the argument.

genre-craft.title: Genre craft
genre-craft.intro: Genre conventions and reader promises: mystery fair play, romance beats, thriller clocks, horror dread, MG/YA, SF.

fields.label: Your story
fields.placeholder: Premise and where you are

fields.label: Question
fields.placeholder: Are my clues fair? Where do the romance beats go? Is the dread building?

interactive-fiction.intro: Branching stories, choice graphs and gamebooks (Twine, Ink).
